question: What fate is overcome through fasting by day?
premises: The target is death associated with age
The practitioner will go beyond it
inference: Through fasting by day, one will overcome death due to aging.
uncertainties: Exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may imply overcoming or reaching beyond death
plain_english: By fasting during the day, one will overcome death from old age.
